root_cause: When a dialog closes, focus is not restored to the element that opened it (the opener), causing keyboard users to lose their place in the UI.
repair_strategy: Add a utility function `restoreFocusToOpener` that focuses a given opener element. The dialog component should capture the opener using `getActiveEl()` when the dialog opens, and call `restoreFocusToOpener(opener)` when the dialog closes.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users will have focus returned to the triggering element after a dialog closes, maintaining focus context and meeting WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order.
functional_risks: If opener element is removed from DOM before dialog closes, focus may be lost.
If opener is not focusable, focus may not restore visibly.
verification_requirements: Test that focus returns to opener after dialog close.
Test with shadow DOM opener elements.
Test with opener removed from DOM.
